name: metroline
description: Subway-map view of your projects across parallel Claude Code sessions: one line per project, one station per stage, and which project is waiting for you.

capture_prompts.title: Record request previews
capture_prompts.description: Store the first 80 characters of each request (secrets masked) so a project without a plan shows what you last asked. Turn off to store no request text at all.

plan_reminder.title: Suggest a plan at session start
plan_reminder.description: When a session starts in a project without METROLINE.md, show a one-line note suggesting /metroline:plan. Shown to you only, never to Claude.
